CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS n8n_elite_memory_events (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, request_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', key TEXT NOT NULL,
  value JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS n8n_elite_action_ledger (
  action_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('claimed','completed','failed')),
  value JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  result JSONB, error JSONB,
  claimed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, failed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM n8n_elite_memory_events) AS memory_events,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger) AS action_total,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger WHERE status='claimed') AS action_claimed,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger WHERE status='completed') AS action_completed,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger WHERE status='failed') AS action_failed,
 (SELECT COUNT(*)::bigint FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger WHERE status='claimed' AND claimed_at < NOW()-INTERVAL '1 hour') AS stale_claims,
 (SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW()-MIN(claimed_at)))::bigint FROM n8n_elite_action_ledger WHERE status='claimed') AS oldest_claim_age_seconds;
